meta.name: discord
meta.description: Send, read, edit, delete, and search Discord messages, reactions, polls, pins, and threads via the message tool. Use when interacting with Discord channels, sending media or embeds, creating polls or threads, managing presence, or moderating messages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Discord 频道中收发消息、管理互动
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化 Discord 消息和互动操作。
copy.tagline_en: Send, read, and manage Discord messages and interactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate Discord messaging and interactions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以发送、读取、编辑、删除 Discord 消息，管理反应、投票、置顶和子话题，还能搜索消息或设置在线状态。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 在 Discord 频道中发消息、查消息、管理投票或子话题时触发。需要先配置 Discord 机器人令牌。

say.text: 在 #general 频道发一条公告，说“维护通知”。
say.note: Claude 会发送消息到指定频道。

say.text: 搜索 #dev 频道里关于“发布”的消息。
给消息 456 添加一个 ✅ 反应。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send, read, edit, delete Discord messages, manage reactions, polls, pins, threads, search messages, or set presence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to interact with Discord channels, e.g., send messages, read, manage polls or threads. Requires a Discord bot token configured.

say_en.text: Post an announcement in #general saying 'Maintenance notice'.
say_en.note: Claude sends the message to the channel.
